sources.title: A Bird Song Detector for improving bird identification through Deep ...
sources.snippet: Our approach demonstrated the effectiveness of integrating a Bird Song Detector with fine-tuned classification models for bird identification at local soundscapes. These findings highlight the need to adapt general-purpose tools for specific ecological challenges, as demonstrated in Doñana.
